extraction.summary_en: This filing (deposited 12/02/2013) records a Président decision of 29 January 2013 transferring ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES' registered seat, plus the updated statutes bearing that decision date. It does not itself move the company's capital. The updated statutes recite the capital's history (Article "Apports") and state the current composition (Article 7): capital of 368,102 euros divided into 368,102 shares of 1 euro nominal, split into 217,241 preference shares A and 150,861 preference shares B. Article 6 (27/06/2008) also mentions a pure nominal split (200,000 euros divided by 100 into 200,000 shares of 1 euro) that changed no aggregate amount.

snapshots.as_of_basis: Current statutes (Article 7 - Capital social) as updated by the Président's decision of 29 January 2013, the date of this filing's statutes.

evidence.quote_fr: Le capital social est fixé à la somme de 368.102 euros. Il est divisé en 368.102 actions de 1 euro chacune entièrement libérées. Il est divisé en actions de préférence de catégorie A et en actions de préférence de catégorie B, à savoir : 217.241 actions de préférence de catégorie A, 150.861 actions de préférence de catégorie B.

issues: The AGE of 27/06/2008 also carried out a pure division of the nominal value by 100 (200,000 shares of 1 euro replacing shares of higher nominal, capital unchanged at €200,000); per the rules this is recorded only as a snapshot, not as a capital event.

No shareholder names or holding percentages are given anywhere in this filing; the A/B preference share split (217,241 / 150,861) is stated only in aggregate, without identifying which associé(s) hold which category.

The creation of the A/B preference share categories is not documented in this filing (it is only restated as an existing feature of the current statutes); no CAPITAL_DUAL_CLASS creation event is emitted here since the creation itself is not evidenced in this act.
